entry.title: Introducing InsightPage Style: Obsidian Plugin for Rich Visualizations & Interactive Notes

link.title: Introducing InsightPage Style: Obsidian Plugin for Rich Visualizations & Interactive Notes

entry.content:
We are thrilled to introduce the official Obsidian community plugin: InsightPage Style (3-ark/insightpage-style)!

InsightPage Style brings the exact same visual components and interactive diagrams powering our web assistant and note vault directly into your local Obsidian desktop experience.

What is InsightPage Style?

While standard Markdown is great for structured text, complex technical notes often require rich visual aids—interactive timelines, responsive charts, geographic maps, musical notation, and discrete inline comments.

InsightPage Style seamlessly integrates these capabilities into Obsidian using familiar Markdown code blocks and custom syntax.

Key Features & Highlights

1. Observable Plot & YAML Charts (plot, chart)

Render declarative data visualizations using Observable Plot and D3, or write concise YAML configurations powered by Chart.js syntax:

  • Chart.js Types: Bar, Line, Pie, Doughnut, Radar, and Sankey diagrams.
  • Observable Plot: Full JavaScript execution context with access to Plot, d3, and vault file loading via fetch().
type: bar
labels: ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"]
series:
  - title: "Productivity Index"
    data: [65, 82, 90, 115]
width: 500px

2. Zoomable Event Timelines (timeline)

Plot milestones, multi-month development phases, and ongoing projects with interactive pan and zoom controls:

  • Supports JSON, YAML, or JS object literals.
  • Category filtering toggles and dynamic “Today” indicator line.
  • SVG export and copy actions built-in.

3. Interactive Leaflet Maps (map, leaflet)

Embed interactive maps directly into your notes:

  • Customizable markers, popups, and radius circles.
  • Polylines and polygons for routes and zones.
  • Support for custom tile servers and raw GeoJSON layers.

4. ABC Sheet Music Notation & Audio Player (abc, abcjs)

Write sheet music with standard ABC notation:

  • Built-in interactive synthesizer audio playback (Play/Pause/Seek).
  • Real-time visual note highlighting synchronized with audio playback.
  • MIDI file export (.midi) and source copy controls.

5. Inline Popover Comments (::cmt[...])

Add compact popover comments directly inside paragraph text:

  • Compact emoji badge trigger in preview mode.
  • Hover or click to reveal formatted callout notes.
  • Clean print and PDF export styling.

Open Source & Community

The plugin is 100% open-source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

  • GitHub Repository: https://github.com/3-ark/insightpage-style
  • Interactive Showcase: Explore live web demos on our Rendering Showcase.
  • Sample Visualizations: Check out Example Chart, Example Map, and Example Timeline.

Check out the repository on GitHub, try it out in your Obsidian vault, and let us know what you think!
entry.summary: We are thrilled to introduce the official Obsidian community plugin: InsightPage Style (3-ark/insightpage-style)!

entry.title: InsightPage v2.5 Release: Hybrid RAG Search & Local LLM Support

link.title: InsightPage v2.5 Release: Hybrid RAG Search & Local LLM Support

entry.content:
We are excited to announce the release of InsightPage v2.5!

This milestone update brings major improvements to search accuracy, local model integration, and note synchronization.

Highlights of v2.5

1. BM25 + Semantic Hybrid RAG

By combining keyword matching (BM25) with semantic embeddings and MMR reranking, InsightPage can now locate exact terms and conceptual matches across thousands of saved notes in milliseconds.

2. Native Support for On-Device Models

You can now connect InsightPage to local model runners like Ollama or LM Studio with zero data leaving your machine.

Read the full documentation in our InsightPage Docs.
entry.summary: We are excited to announce the release of InsightPage v2.5!

entry.title: Welcome to the Product Wiki & Engineering Blog

link.title: Welcome to the Product Wiki & Engineering Blog

entry.content:
Welcome to our combined product wiki and blog repository!

This site serves two main purposes:

  1. Product Documentation (/docs/): Comprehensive user guides, architecture specifications, and API documentation for our products like InsightPage Assistant.
  2. Product Blog (/blog/): Engineering updates, product announcements, and technical deep dives.

How This Wiki Works

This wiki is hosted directly on GitHub Pages powered by Jekyll. Markdown files placed in docs/ automatically form the documentation tree, while articles placed in _posts/ automatically populate the product blog.

Stay tuned for more updates!
